title: K-Pop
tagline: Korean popular music shaped by performance, production, and global fandom.
summary: K-pop is South Korea's broad popular-music industry, encompassing pop, hip-hop, R&B, dance, and electronic influences. Carefully produced recordings, choreography, visual concepts, and group performance are central to many acts. The music's global reach has grown through digital platforms and dedicated fan communities.

pillars.name: Seo Taiji and Boys
pillars.why: Their early-1990s blend of Korean lyrics with contemporary pop and hip-hop is widely seen as a turning point.

pillars.name: BoA
pillars.why: BoA became an early Korean pop star with major success in South Korea and Japan.

pillars.name: BIGBANG
pillars.why: BIGBANG helped shape the modern idol group's sound and creative identity through songwriting and performance.
